meta.title: Kaavosh — Programming learning paths, from zero to hired
meta.description: Bilingual learning paths, step-by-step interview questions and code-animated concept explainers for the 2026 programming job market.
meta.keywords: learning paths, interview questions, programming, frontend, backend, devops, AI, cybersecurity

hero.subtitle: Six career paths, every interview question broken into beginner-friendly steps, and concepts you can watch instead of reading — all in Persian and English.

terminal.caption: Every concept, explained like a story

paths.title: One clear road, from your first line of code to job-ready
paths.subtitle: Each path is a sequence of stages with real durations, hand-picked resources and an animated explainer for the hard ideas.

how.title: Four steps, zero guesswork
how.subtitle: The whole site is built around one idea: big scary topics become small friendly steps.

step1.title: Pick your road
step1.detail: Six paths — frontend, backend, DevOps & cloud, mobile, AI/ML and cybersecurity. Each one shows total duration and the jobs it leads to.

step2.title: Watch ideas move
step2.detail: Hard concepts come alive as code-drawn animations: an HTTP request travels, the event loop spins, containers multiply. No videos to download — it all runs in your browser.

step3.title: Drill the questions
step3.detail: Real interview questions with the 30-second answer first, then the same answer broken into small steps a total beginner can follow.

step4.title: Walk in confident
step4.detail: Track what you've covered, revisit the glossary, and walk into the interview already speaking the team's language.

explainers.title: See the idea, not just the words
explainers.subtitle: When someone says “the browser sends a request”, most people see nothing in their head. These animations fix that — they're drawn with code, so they load instantly and stay crisp.

interview.title: Answers built for real interviews
interview.subtitle: Each question gives you the short answer you say out loud, the step-by-step version that teaches it, typical follow-ups, and the code that proves it.

stats.title: Everything is real and complete
stats.subtitle: No “coming soon” placeholders — every number below is content that exists on this site right now.

faq.title: Questions people actually ask
faq.subtitle: The short version of what this site is and how to use it.

cta.title: Ready to start stage 01?
cta.subtitle: Pick a path and let the first animated concept load — that's the whole commitment.

pathsPage.title: Choose the road that fits you
pathsPage.subtitle: Every path is written from absolute zero — no prior knowledge assumed — up to the level teams actually hire for.
pathsPage.roadmapSubtitle: Scroll slowly — the road draws itself as you go.

interviewPage.title: Real questions, step-by-step answers
interviewPage.subtitle: Pick a field. Every question starts with the answer you'd say in the room, then teaches it in small steps.
interviewPage.sourcesSubtitle: The most-starred, actively-maintained GitHub repos for interview prep — stars and last-push dates verified via the GitHub API on November 18, 2026.

glossaryPage.title: Speak the team's language
